title: Ask tab: question/answer chat about the transcript
description: Let the user ask questions about the conversation and get streamed answers that use the previous Q&A as context; the history is saved with the session (goal 4).
steps: Create `ui/session/AskViewModel.kt`: constructor `(sessionId, repository, chatClient, settings)`. State `data class AskUiState(val messages: List<ChatMessageEntity> = emptyList(), val streaming: String = "", val running: Boolean = false, val error: String? = null, val configured: Boolean = true)`; messages from `observeMessages(QA)`.

`fun ask(question: String)`: ignore if blank or running. Save the USER message first. Build the prompt with `PromptBuilder.question(transcript, maxChars, history, question)` where history = the previously saved QA messages (before this question) mapped to `LlmMessage("user"/"assistant", content)`. Stream into `streaming`; on completion save the ASSISTANT message. On error set `error` and save nothing for the assistant (the user message stays, so the user can retry with `fun retryLast()` which re-sends the last USER message without saving it again). `fun clearHistory()` clears QA messages.

In `SessionScreen` replace the Ask tab placeholder: same not-configured state as Summary. Else a `LazyColumn` of chat bubbles (user right-aligned with `primaryContainer`, assistant left with `surfaceVariant`, text selectable), the streaming answer as a live bubble, error with "Retry", and a bottom row with an `OutlinedTextField` ("Ask about this conversation…", ImeAction.Send) and a send `IconButton`. Overflow item "Clear questions" calls `clearHistory()`. Auto-scroll to the bottom when messages change.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: `ask("Who decided?")` with fake streaming "Bob" saves USER then ASSISTANT messages in order
Test: the second question's prompt contains the first Q and A as history (inspect what the fake received)
Test: on LlmException the USER message is saved, no ASSISTANT message, error set; `retryLast()` succeeds without duplicating the USER message
Test: blank question does nothing; `clearHistory()` empties messages
